name: sumi-reader
description: A quiet, local PDF reader for macOS
author: kairi7011

scripts.start: node scripts/prepare-frontend.mjs --debug && node scripts/build-tauri.mjs --debug && node scripts/start-tauri.mjs
scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/desktop.js && node --check src/page-turn.js && node --check src/page-map.js && node --check src/page-zoom.js && node --check src/book-title.js && node --check scripts/prepare-frontend.mjs && node --check scripts/build-tauri.mjs && node --check scripts/package-tauri.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p library_test.py
